title: Cortisol modulates calcium release-activated calcium channel gating in fish hepatocytes.
authors: Das, Chinmayee; Rout, Manoj K; Wildering, Willem C; Vijayan, Mathilakath M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究皮质醇通过CRAC通道调节鱼类肝细胞钙信号，涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are rapidly released in response to stress and play an important role in the physiological adjustments to re-establish homeostasis. The mode of action of GCs for stress coping is mediated largely by the steroid binding to the glucocorticoid receptor (GR), a ligand-bound transcription factor, and modulating the expression of target genes. However, GCs also exert rapid actions that are independent of transcriptional regulation by modulating second messenger signaling. However, a membrane-specific protein that transduces rapid GCs signal is yet to be characterized. Here, using freshly isolated hepatocytes from rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) and fura2 fluorescence microscopy, we report that stressed levels of cortisol rapidly stimulate the rise in cytosolic free calcium ([Ca(2+)]i). Pharmacological manipulations using specific extra- and intra-cellular calcium chelators, plasma membrane and endoplasmic reticulum channel blockers and receptors, indicated extracellular Ca(2+) entry is required for the cortisol-mediated rise in ([Ca(2+)]i). Particularly, the calcium release-activated calcium (CRAC) channel gating appears to be a key target for the rapid action of cortisol in the ([Ca(2+)]i) rise in trout hepatocytes. To test this further, we carried out in silico molecular docking studies using the Drosophila CRAC channel modulator 1 (ORAI1) protein, the pore forming subunit of CRAC channel that is highly conserved. The result predicts a putative binding site on CRAC for cortisol to modulate channel gating, suggesting a direct, as well as an indirect regulation (by other membrane receptors) of CRAC channel gating by cortisol. Altogether, CRAC channel may be a novel cortisol-gated Ca(2+) channel transducing rapid nongenomic signalling in hepatocytes during acute stress.
abstract_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）在应激反应中迅速释放，并在重新建立稳态的生理调节中发挥重要作用。GCs应对应激的作用机制主要通过类固醇与糖皮质激素受体（GR）结合，后者是一种配体结合的转录因子，并调节靶基因的表达。然而，GCs还通过调节第二信使信号传导发挥不依赖于转录调控的快速作用。尽管如此，介导GCs快速信号传导的膜特异性蛋白尚未被表征。在此，我们使用虹鳟鱼（Oncorhynchus mykiss）新鲜分离的肝细胞和fura2荧光显微镜，报道应激水平的皮质醇迅速刺激胞质游离钙（[Ca(2+)]i）升高。通过使用特异性细胞外和细胞内钙螯合剂、质膜和内质网通道阻断剂及受体的药理学操作，表明皮质醇介导的（[Ca(2+)]i）升高需要细胞外Ca(2+)内流。特别是，钙释放激活钙（CRAC）通道的门控似乎是皮质醇在虹鳟鱼肝细胞中快速升高（[Ca(2+)]i）的关键靶点。为进一步验证这一点，我们使用果蝇CRAC通道调节因子1（ORAI1）蛋白（CRAC通道的孔形成亚基，高度保守）进行了计算机分子对接研究。结果预测了皮质醇在CRAC上调节通道门控的潜在结合位点，表明皮质醇对CRAC通道门控存在直接以及间接（通过其他膜受体）调节。总体而言，CRAC通道可能是一种新型的皮质醇门控Ca(2+)通道，在急性应激期间介导肝细胞中的快速非基因组信号传导。
